deployments_detail.use: ADO (AI-based Design space Optimization) in vaccine manufacturing (2024, domestic-first vaccine AI); ROTOR AI clinical decision-support (Gates Foundation, 2026)

ADO (AI-based Design space Optimization) — AI system that analyzes vaccine process design-of-experiments (DoE) data and predicts high-success process conditions, cutting the number of physical experiments. In a bacterial-vaccine protein-conjugate POC it shortened the experimental-design period to one-third; developed over ~1.5 years with SK Discovery Group's DX Lab and now in full deployment, being extended to other processes. [SK Discovery DX Lab (in-house)]

ROTOR platform — Gates Foundation-funded AI platform for evidence-based clinical development decision-making. Analyzes clinical, immunogenicity and scientific datasets to reduce uncertainty in advancing vaccines to Phase III (e.g. next-gen injectable rotavirus vaccine), aiming to become a scalable multi-disease AI solution for LMIC vaccine developers. SK Bioscience is lead/主관 organization. [PATH, Slalom, SK AX; funded by Gates Foundation]

Computational/AI-based antigen design for SKYCovione (GBP510) — self-assembled nanoparticle COVID-19 vaccine co-developed with the Institute for Protein Design (David Baker, University of Washington) using computational/AI protein design. Described as the world's first computationally designed protein-based COVID-19 vaccine; licensed in Korea (2022) and granted WHO Emergency Use Listing (2023). [Institute for Protein Design, University of Washington (David Baker)]

GBP511 pan-Sarbecovirus (universal coronavirus) vaccine developed with AI-based protein design technology (IPD/David Baker), targeting the broad coronavirus family for future variants; entered clinical trials in February 2026 and tied to CEPI's 100-Day Mission for rapid pandemic response. [Institute for Protein Design (University of Washington); CEPI]

Digital-twin simulation and ML-driven hypothesis generation for vaccine R&D — digital twin-based process simulation combined with machine learning optimization aimed at shortening overall vaccine development timelines by more than 30%. [none]
deployments_detail.value: Targeting 30%+ reduction in vaccine development time

deployments_detail.use: Golden Batch manufacturing optimization — machine learning applied to hundreds of bioprocess variables (temperature, flow rate, culture conditions) to identify the optimal combination ('Golden Batch') that maximizes yield/quality consistency in vaccine/biologics production and enable production forecasting. [none]

Generative-AI regulatory document automation — AI drafts regulatory filings (Common Technical Document / CTD) from accumulated research files and reviews data; data review reduced from ~2 weeks to ~2 minutes (with full human-reviewed processing in about 1 week). [none]
deployments_detail.value: Data review cut from ~2 weeks to ~2 minutes

deployments_detail.use: Enterprise AI agents / '1 person, 1 agent' program — SK Bioscience plans to have 100+ internal AI agents operational by year-end 2026 to boost employee productivity across R&D, production and management, framed by CIO/CDO Hwang Jae-sun as future competitiveness measured by how many agents each employee works with. [none]
